entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""This cannot be a coincidence. I ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "This cannot be a coincidence. I had time to look over the police reports, and I don't buy any of it."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""This is big.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is big."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I had time to look over the police..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had time to look over the police reports but I don't buy it. There is something fishy about his death."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I trust the police reports, Lucian..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust the police reports, Lucian. I don't see why you wouldn't."
entries.menuText: "I trust the police reports, Lucian. I don't see why you wouldn't."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked worried."
entries.dialogueText: He looked worried.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I agree. We can't trust the report..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. We can't trust the reports."
entries.menuText: "I agree. We can't trust the reports."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lucian. There is something I need..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucian. There is something I need to tell you."
entries.menuText: "Lucian. There is something I need to tell you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I gave the order.""
entries.dialogueText: "I gave the order."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was Karl.""
entries.dialogueText: "It was Karl."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Sir? So you knew about this?""
entries.dialogueText: "Sir? So you knew about this?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave me a questioning look."
entries.dialogueText: He gave me a questioning look.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I see now. It was your order.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see now. It was your order."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What did you think?""
entries.dialogueText: "What did you think?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It all makes sense.""
entries.dialogueText: "It all makes sense."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked surprised for a moment."
entries.dialogueText: He looked surprised for a moment.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Sir... I don't see why you didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir... I don't see why you didn't share such vital information with me. You know you can trust me with anything."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""In order for me to plan the best s..."
entries.dialogueText: "In order for me to plan the best strategies for you, I cannot be left in the dark."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I understand Lucian. Now you know.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand Lucian. Now you know."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I won't keep you in the dark again.""
entries.dialogueText: "I won't keep you in the dark again."
entries.menuText: "I won't keep you in the dark again."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't question me Lucian. I told y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't question me Lucian. I told you now, didn't I?"
entries.menuText: "Don't question me Lucian. I told you now, didn't I?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Thank you, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes sir. Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes sir. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""This might bring suspicion on our..."
entries.dialogueText: "This might bring suspicion on our administration. We must be careful."

entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You should take a look at them in..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should take a look at them in detail. This might bring suspicion on our administration. We must be careful."

entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""In any case, we should discuss thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any case, we should discuss this later. With the whole intelligence team."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade

entries.dialogueText: "But I have to say the death of the Chief Justice isn't particularly bad for us. This is mostly good news."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""He was our greatest obstacle.""
entries.dialogueText: "He was our greatest obstacle."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But I have to say the death of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I have to say the death of the Chief Justice was unnervingly timely, given the status of your impeachment investigation..."

entries.dialogueText: "Sir. You can be honest with me. Did you have anything to do with this?"

entries.dialogueText: "No. What are you trying to say?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm not trying to say anything. Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not trying to say anything. You couldn't have been luckier, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But I have to say, the BFF murderi..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I have to say, the BFF murdering Frens Ricter doesn't make any sense. This clearly must have been staged."

entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""In any case, now that the seat of..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any case, now that the seat of Mr. Hawker is vacant, the Court will be voting on a new Chief Justice."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mrs. Edmonds and Mr. Garaci seem t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mrs. Edmonds and Mr. Garaci seem to be the contenders to become the new chief. However, Mrs. Edmonds doesn't have much chance in my opinion."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The Supreme Court would never elec..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Supreme Court would never elect a woman."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I have organized several events ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have organized several events around Greater Holsord and Nargis to promote our party and talk about our achievements."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Our most successful mayors will be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our most successful mayors will be leading the campaigns in their cities."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""They've asked for a budget increas..."
entries.dialogueText: "They've asked for a budget increase in order to campaign more effectively."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's not going to happen.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's not going to happen."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll give them whatever they need.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll give them whatever they need."
entries.menuText: "I'll give them whatever they need." [-1 Personal Wealth]

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That's a shame, sir. It could have..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a shame, sir. It could have helped our chances of success."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That will certainly help our chanc..."
entries.dialogueText: "That will certainly help our chances of success."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mr. Holl and I have been working o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Holl and I have been working on several possible plans to boost the economy, as is our focus."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""He is currently compiling a very d..."
entries.dialogueText: "He is currently compiling a very detailed report with suggested projects."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'll make sure you have a chance t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll make sure you have a chance to see it soon."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I have talked to the USP leadershi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have talked to the USP leadership about possible changes to the party, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Changing our core values doesn't s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Changing our core values doesn't seem to sit well with party members in general."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But I made sure that they understa..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I made sure that they understand who the current leader of the party is. It is still possible to add minor changes to the platform."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I handed him the draft and we start..."
entries.dialogueText: I handed him the draft and we started discussing it.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "...socialist."
entries.dialogueText: ...socialist.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We could go over the details of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could go over the details of the new manifesto if you want. I believe you've already made a draft."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. Let's do it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Let's do it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I handed him the draft and we start..."
entries.dialogueText: I handed him the draft and we started discussing it.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: The draft outlined a new set of principles that were...

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "...ultranationalist."
entries.dialogueText: ...ultranationalist.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "...neo-Sollist."
entries.dialogueText: ...neo-Sollist.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a brief silence."
entries.dialogueText: There was a brief silence.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "...liberal."
entries.dialogueText: ...liberal.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Before we move on, I must also say..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before we move on, I must also say that the Supreme Court is furious with what we have done. Our public campaign against them is working."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I wouldn't be so sure. Mrs. Edmond..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't be so sure. Mrs. Edmonds is quite a power player."
entries.menuText: "I wouldn't be so sure. Mrs. Edmonds is quite a power player."

entries.menuText: "We can't let them elect Mr. Garaci. He is no different than Hawker."

entries.dialogueText: "I told you that I will reshuffle the Court. They are contenders for nothing."
entries.menuText: "I told you that I will reshuffle the Court. They are contenders for nothing."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""This will surely have unforeseen c..."
entries.dialogueText: "This will surely have unforeseen consequences. We'll need to be ready for anything."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I see...""
entries.dialogueText: "I see..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We were in the middle of organizin..."
entries.dialogueText: "We were in the middle of organizing the Assembly against Orso's impeachment, too. While this makes things easy for us, it could also bring us unwanted attention."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We will have to wait and see.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will have to wait and see."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I already have a list of names for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I already have a list of names for you as you asked. We can do a complete reshuffle of the Court."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.menuText: "With Orso gone, maybe we should leave the Court as it is for now."

entries.dialogueText: The names that stood out to me were Gloria Tory, Ovid Grecer and Didier Meye. Mr. Grecer was an experienced judge and Mr. Meye was loyal to the party.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I have some other news for you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have some other news for you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He straightened up again."
entries.dialogueText: He straightened up again.

entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""People were already blaming the Co..."

entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""I have to make sure our tracks are..."

entries.dialogueText: The line dropped. I hung up and turned back to Lucian.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""There's a large group of NFP membe..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's a large group of NFP members outside protesting the removal of 'Sord' from the Constitution. They didn't let me through easily."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Lastly...""
entries.dialogueText: "Lastly..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He placed a stack of paper in front..."
entries.dialogueText: He placed a stack of paper in front of me.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Ms. Graf sent the plans for the ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ms. Graf sent the plans for the abolishment of the Special Zone of Bergia."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We can try passing it through the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can try passing it through the Assembly if you sign it."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Ms. Morgna sent the plans for the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ms. Morgna sent the plans for the Semi-autonomous Zone of Bergia."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We can try passing it through the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can try passing it through the Assembly if you sign it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's too late now. You can take it..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's too late now. You can take it back. I won't sign it."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I signed the documents."
entries.dialogueText: I signed the documents.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I signed the documents."
entries.dialogueText: I signed the documents.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As you wish, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, sir."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was Remus.""
entries.dialogueText: "It was Remus."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The most suggested name was crossed..."
entries.dialogueText: The most suggested name was crossed out. I wondered why.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The only names stood up to me with..."
entries.dialogueText: The only names stood up to me with a slight possibility of getting elected were Gloria Tory and Didier Meye, a loyalist judge.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lucian. Why is the top name crosse..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucian. Why is the top name crossed?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Well... He suddenly changed his mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... He suddenly changed his mind and said that he no longer wishes to become a Justice in the Supreme Court."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Unfortunately, he's not an option..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, he's not an option anymore. As far as I'm aware, he wasn't a target that was in anyone's radar, but his sudden flip still sounds fishy."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""He was the most experienced and de..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was the most experienced and deserving judge in the list to serve on the Supreme Court."
